description: For agencies and communications teams: submit a press release, follow its status and get the published URL for the client report. We email a confirmation request to the given sender address; the review starts only after that email is answered. Publication is an editorial decision, not guaranteed. Free allowance and packages apply per sender address (see ver_condiciones). Moves no money.

email.description: Email address of the agency or company that sends the release. It receives the confirmation request, offers and invoices.

empresa.description: Company the release is about (max 120 characters).

enlace.description: One link the release should carry, full https address (optional). Free releases link with nofollow, paid ones with rel=sponsored.

idioma.description: Language of the release text as a two-letter code, e.g. es, en, ca (optional; any language, we publish in Spanish).

medio_preferido.description: Preferred publication; only a hint, the editorial review decides.

rubrica.description: Preferred section, one of the sections listed by ver_medios (optional; only a hint, the editorial review decides).

texto.description: Full text of the release, 400 to 20,000 characters, plain text or simple paragraphs.

texto_enlace.description: Text for that link, up to 100 characters (optional, needs enlace).

name: enviar_nota
title: Submit a press release
